title_zh: 算清剧场筹款结余再询问坡道报价

scenario.goal_zh: 确认可用筹款和下一项空间改善工作

context_zh: 社区剧场志愿者阿莎与财务志愿者托比一起核对虚构筹款活动的账目。
author: author-phase06-a

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: We sold four hundred pounds of tickets. How much did the event cost us?

sentences.speaker: Toby
sentences.text: One hundred and fifty pounds, including thirty for printing and one hundred and twenty for the room.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: What percentage of our costs went on printing?

sentences.speaker: Toby
sentences.text: Twenty percent. Thirty is one fifth of one hundred and fifty.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: So our profit was two hundred and fifty pounds after all the costs?

sentences.speaker: Toby
sentences.text: Yes. That is the amount we can put towards improving the entrance.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: The access group asked about a ramp. Can we tell them we will install one?

sentences.speaker: Toby
sentences.text: Not yet. We need a proper assessment and a price first.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: Then I will ask the building manager to arrange that and explain that we have two hundred and fifty pounds available.

sentences.speaker: Toby
sentences.text: Good. I will send you the income-and-cost summary to take with you.
